instruction:
Use the ANSYS Mechanical APDL GUI to complete the following analysis:

Physical problem: modal analysis of a beam fixed at both ends.

Model parameters:
- Beam cross section 10 mm x 10 mm, length 500 mm
- Material: steel, E = 210000 MPa, nu = 0.3, density 7850 kg/m^3
- Element: BEAM188
- Section: rectangle 10x10 mm
- Mesh: 20 equal divisions along the beam length

Boundary conditions:
- Both ends: all DOFs constrained

Analysis type: modal analysis, extract first 3 modes

Save requirements:
- Database file: apdl_fixed_beam_modal.db
- Result file (.rst) must exist in the working directory
